Package neqsim.process.processmodel.diagram

Class ProcessDiagramGraphAdapter

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.diagram.ProcessDiagramGraphAdapter
public final class ProcessDiagramGraphAdapter extends Object
Adapts runnable process topology to the canonical, exchange-independent EngineeringGraph used by diagram and DEXPI workflows.

The adapter does not render a drawing and does not copy execution scheduling state. It creates stable plant, area, equipment, port, and physical-connection identities that later DOT, SVG/PDF, and DEXPI exporters can consume. The returned ProcessDiagramGraphAdapter.Result stores an immutable JSON snapshot and returns a defensive graph copy to every caller.

    • fromProcessSystem

      public static ProcessDiagramGraphAdapter.Result fromProcessSystem(ProcessSystem processSystem, String plantId, String revision, String operatingCaseId)
      Builds one canonical diagram snapshot with selected current stream operating values.

      This opt-in overload preserves the topology-only output of the established three-argument method. Values are captured only after a successful process run and are represented as unit-explicit, case-scoped calculation nodes with simulation-result provenance and review-required status.

      Parameters:
      processSystem - process system; unsuccessful run state produces a diagnostic rather than values
      plantId - persistent plant or project identifier
      revision - controlled source-model revision
      operatingCaseId - stable operating-case identifier
      Returns:
      immutable canonical snapshot and diagnostics

    • fromProcessModel

      public static ProcessDiagramGraphAdapter.Result fromProcessModel(ProcessModel processModel, String plantId, String revision, String operatingCaseId)
      Builds one plant-wide canonical diagram snapshot with selected current stream operating values.

      One operating-case node owns the values captured across every successfully run area. An area that has not completed successfully is retained topologically and reported through a structured diagnostic; stale values are not published for that area.

      Parameters:
      processModel - multi-area process model; each unsuccessful area produces a diagnostic rather than values
      plantId - persistent plant or project identifier
      revision - controlled source-model revision
      operatingCaseId - stable plant-wide operating-case identifier
      Returns:
      immutable plant-wide canonical snapshot and diagnostics
